checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same man, short grey hair, recognisable features
must.why: Similar hair, stubble and face structure, though he looks a bit older with more wrinkles.
Charcoal blazer over white open-collar shirt.
Blurred living room or office with shelves and window.

must.item: Harsh lighting softened, realistic skin texture
must.why: Soft even light and natural skin texture with pores and wrinkles.
Clean result with no visible artifacts, though the crop is portrait and slightly tighter.

faults.what: Expression changed from neutral to a smile, and the face has extra wrinkles and looks slightly different and older; some identity drift.
Aspect ratio changed from square to portrait.

summary: A polished professional headshot with a blazer, white shirt and soft blurred background that keeps the man's likeness, with only a changed smile and slight aging as minor drift.
